problem_observed: Raw section KK files may start too abruptly and may not include padding, Twinkle, or receiver-safe presentation treatment.
core_rule: A raw KK micro-capture is not automatically buyer-ready delivery audio.

raw_micro_capture.purpose: Exact audio extraction from PIX/source for structural and meaning proof.

review_render.purpose: Human listening version with enough lead padding/fade to judge emotional meaning safely.

buyer_safety_rule: Public pages and Stripe checkout must use buyer_hug_render or explicitly approved review_render, never raw_micro_capture by default.
